$comment: The faculty/content registry -- answers 'what does this tenant teach', nothing about bot processes/tokens (that's telegram/config/bots.json, added 2026-08-10 -- see bots.README.md). Adding a faculty entry here with content_scope filled in is meant to be the ENTIRE onboarding step for shared-1LAVYA-content access -- no bot code should need to change. own_content additions are separate, deliberately slower work (see own_content.status below) -- never conflate the two.

tenants.notes: The flagship, unrestricted 1LAVYA bot -- every course/level/subject in the shared catalog. See telegram/config/bots.json for its token/bot identity.

Flagship MCQ/descriptive practice bot, unrestricted scope. See telegram/config/bots.json for its token/bot identity. STANDING RULE, locked 2026-08-13 (Pranav): EVERY question that exists on this platform -- shared-1LAVYA-authored or faculty-sourced -- becomes part of THIS bot's pool. A faculty's own bot stays narrowly scoped to their own content_scope (unaffected by this rule); this tenant's exam_content is the one place that always gets everything, no exceptions. Provenance is tracked via `_content_owner` (exam_hub_bot.py, inferred from each source file's path -- '.../faculty/<tenant_id>/...' -> that tenant_id, everything else -> '1lavya'), never via withholding content from this pool. mcq_json is a LIST (added 2026-08-11) -- the first entry is CA Inter Advanced Accounting, auto-regenerated by telegram/tools/build_exam_bot_mcq_export.py; the second is CA Foundation Quantitative Aptitude, a separately-owned batch regenerated by telegram/tools/build_ca_foundation_quants_mcq_export.py. The 3rd and 4th (added 2026-08-12) are CA Foundation Accounting and Business Economics -- one-time ingestion via telegram/tools/ingest_ca_foundation_accounting_economics_mcqs.py from 2 raw staging folders Pranav provided (see COURSE-CATALOG.md's 'CA Foundation Accounting' entries for the full defect-fixing/normalization story). The 5th (added 2026-08-13) is CMA Foundation + Intermediate Law (1,025 MCQs, csarunchouhan's tenant). descriptive_json became a LIST the same day, for the same reason -- csarunchouhan's own 47-question Companies Act descriptive bank joined the flagship's original 455. All entries are loaded and merged at bot startup (see exam_hub_bot.py's QuestionBank/McqBank) -- add every future subject/faculty batch here the same way, MCQ and descriptive both, per the standing rule above.

own_content.shape: 2 PDFs, both Revision-Material-style handwritten notes (AS02 Inventory, AS10 PPE) -- no Study Materials, no Exam Materials of his own; relies entirely on the shared 1LAVYA pool for exam content within content_scope above.
